# Med Record (سجلي الطبي) — AI Context & Specifications

> Med Record is a bilingual (Arabic-first, RTL) unified family health record system and clinical practice management SaaS platform launched in 2026 in Cairo, Egypt.

## Machine Discovery, Authentication & Specifications
- **OIDC Discovery (RFC 8414 / OpenID Connect)**: https://med-record-delta.vercel.app/.well-known/openid-configuration
- **OAuth 2.0 Authorization Server Metadata**: https://med-record-delta.vercel.app/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server
- **JWKS Keys Endpoint**: https://med-record-delta.vercel.app/.well-known/jwks.json
- **API Catalog (RFC 9727 Linkset)**: https://med-record-delta.vercel.app/.well-known/api-catalog
- **OpenAPI 3.1 YAML Specification**: https://med-record-delta.vercel.app/openapi.yaml
- **OpenAPI 3.1 JSON Specification**: https://med-record-delta.vercel.app/openapi.json
- **MCP Server Card**: https://med-record-delta.vercel.app/.well-known/mcp.json
- **MCP Streamable HTTP Endpoint**: https://med-record-delta.vercel.app/mcp
- **Sitemap XML**: https://med-record-delta.vercel.app/sitemap.xml

## Services & Core Offerings
1. **Family Health Space**: 100% Free (0 EGP) personal health record for parents & children.
2. **Pediatrics Practice EMR**: 250 EGP/month per physician with WHO growth percentiles.
3. **Clinical Nutrition Practice EMR**: 250 EGP/month per specialist with BMR/TDEE calculations.
4. **Live Clinic Queue Engine**: Real-time waiting room orchestration for receptionists.
5. **Secure Digital Prescription Vault**: QR-verified prescriptions and letterheads.
